pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Protects Pokémon on the user's side of the field from major status effects and confusion for five turns.  Does not cancel existing ailments.  This effect remains even if the user leaves the field.

If yawn is used while this move is in effect, it will immediately fail.

defog used by an opponent will end this effect.

This effect does not prevent the confusion caused by outrage, petal dance, or thrash.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Protects the user's field from major status ailments and confusion for five turns.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a $effect_chance% chance to burn the target.  Frozen Pokémon may use this move, in which case they will thaw.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Has a $effect_chance% chance to burn the target.  Lets frozen Pokémon thaw themselves.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  Power is selected at random between 10 and 150, with an average of 71:

Magnitude | Power | Chance
--------: | ----: | -----:
        4 |    10 |     5%
        5 |    30 |    10%
        6 |    50 |    20%
        7 |    70 |    30%
        8 |    90 |    20%
        9 |   110 |    10%
       10 |   150 |     5%

This move has double power against Pokémon currently underground due to dig.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Power varies randomly from 10 to 150.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
User switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party.  Stat changes, confusion, and persistent move effects are passed along to the replacement Pokémon.

The following move effects are passed:

* aqua ring
* both the user's and target's effect of block, mean look, and spider web
* the curse effect of curse
* embargo
* focus energy or an activated lansat berry
* gastro acid
* ingrain
* being sapped by leech seed
* being targeted by lock on or mind reader
* magnet rise
* perish song's counter
* power trick
* substitute; the doll's HP is unchanged

The replacement Pokémon does not trigger effects that respond to Pokémon switching in.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Allows the trainer to switch out the user and pass effects along to its replacement.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  If the target attempts to switch out this turn before the user acts, this move hits the target before it leaves and has double power.

This effect can still hit a Pokémon that switches out when it has a substitute up or when an ally has used follow me.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Has double power against, and can hit, Pokémon attempting to switch out.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Removes leech seed from the user, frees the user from bind, clamp, fire spin, magma storm, sand tomb, whirlpool, and wrap, and clears spikes, stealth rock, and toxic spikes from the user's side of the field.  If this move misses or has no effect, its effect doesn't activate.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Frees the user from binding moves, removes Leech Seed, and blows away Spikes.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Inflicts exactly 20 damage.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Inflicts 20 points of damage.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Heals the user for half its max HP.

During sunny day, the healing is increased to 2/3 max HP.

During hail, rain dance, or sandstorm, the healing is decreased to 1/4 max HP.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Heals the user by half its max HP.  Affected by weather.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  Power and type are determined by the user's IVs.

Power is given by `x * 40 / 63 + 30`.  `x` is obtained by arranging bit 1 from the IV for each of Special Defense, Special Attack, Speed, Defense, Attack, and HP in that order.  (Bit 1 is 1 if the IV is of the form `4n + 2` or `4n + 3`.  `x` is then 64 * Special Defense IV bit 1, plus 32 * Special Attack IV bit 1, etc.)

Power is always between 30 and 70, inclusive.  Average power is 49.5.

Type is given by `y * 15 / 63`, where `y` is similar to `x` above, except constructed from bit 0.  (Bit 0 is 1 if the IV is odd.)  The result is looked up in the following table.

Value | Type
----: | --------
    0 | fighting
    1 | flying
    2 | poison
    3 | ground
    4 | rock
    5 | bug
    6 | ghost
    7 | steel
    8 | fire
    9 | water
   10 | grass
   11 | electric
   12 | psychic
   13 | ice
   14 | dragon
   15 | dark

This move thus cannot be normal.  Most other types have an equal 1/16 chance to be selected, given random IVs.  However, due to the flooring used here, bug, fighting, and grass appear 5/64 of the time, and dark only 1/64 of the time.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Power and type depend upon user's IVs.  Power can range from 30 to 70.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Changes the weather to rain for five turns, during which water moves inflict 50% extra damage, and fire moves inflict half damage.

If the user is holding damp rock, this effect lasts for eight turns.

thunder has 100% accuracy.  If the target has used detect or protect, thunder has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection.

solar beam has half power.

moonlight, morning sun, and synthesis heal only 1/4 of the user's max HP.

Pokémon with swift swim have doubled original Speed.

Pokémon with forecast become water.

Pokémon with dry skin heal 1/8 max HP, Pokémon with hydration are cured of major status effects, and Pokémon with rain dish heal 1/16 max HP at the end of each turn.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Changes the weather to rain for five turns.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Changes the weather to sunshine for five turns, during which fire moves inflict 50% extra damage, and water moves inflict half damage.

If the user is holding heat rock, this effect lasts for eight turns.

Pokémon cannot become frozen.

thunder has 50% accuracy.

solar beam skips its charge turn.

moonlight, morning sun, and synthesis heal 2/3 of the user's max HP.

Pokémon with chlorophyll have doubled original Speed.

Pokémon with forecast become fire.

Pokémon with leaf guard are not affected by major status effects.

Pokémon with flower gift change form; every Pokémon on their side of the field have their original Attack and Special Attack increased by 50%.

Pokémon with dry skin lose 1/8 max HP at the end of each turn.

Pokémon with solar power have their original Special Attack raised by 50% but lose 1/8 their max HP at the end of each turn.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Changes the weather to sunny for five turns.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a $effect_chance% chance to raise the user's Defense one stage.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Has a $effect_chance% chance to raise the user's Defense by one stage.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a $effect_chance% chance to raise the user's Attack one stage.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Has a $effect_chance% chance to raise the user's Attack by one stage.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a $effect_chance% chance to raise all of the user's stats one stage.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Has a $effect_chance% chance to raise all of the user's stats by one stage.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: User pays half its max HP to raise its Attack to +6 stages.  If the user cannot pay the HP cost, this move will fail.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: User pays half its max HP to max out its Attack.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Discards the user's stat changes and copies the target's.

This move cannot be copied by mirror move.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Discards the user's stat changes and copies the target's.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Targets the last opposing Pokémon to hit the user with a special move this turn.  Inflicts twice the damage that move did to the user.  If there is no eligible target, this move will fail.  Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored.

This move cannot be copied by mirror move, nor selected by assist or metronome.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Inflicts twice the damage the user received from the last special hit it took.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  Raises the user's Defense by one stage.  User then charges for one turn before attacking.

This move cannot be selected by sleep talk.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Raises the user's Defense by one stage.  User charges for one turn before attacking.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  Has a $effect_chance% chance to make each target flinch.

If the target is under the effect of bounce, fly, or sky drop, this move will hit with double power.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Has a $effect_chance% chance to make the target flinch.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.

If the target is in the first turn of dig, this move will hit with double power.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Dig users.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Inflicts typeless regular damage at the end of the third turn, starting with this one.  This move cannot score a critical hit.  If the target switches out, its replacement will be hit instead.  Damage is calculated at the time this move is used; stat changes and switching out during the delay won't change the damage inflicted.  No move with this effect can be used against the same target again until after the end of the third turn.

This effect breaks through wonder guard.

If the target is protected by protect or detect on the turn this move is used, this move will fail.  However, the damage on the third turn will break through protection.

The damage is applied at the end of the turn, so it ignores endure and focus sash.

This move cannot be copied by mirror move.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Hits the target two turns later.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.

If the target is under the effect of bounce, fly, or sky drop, this move will hit with double power.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Pokémon in the air.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  Has a $effect_chance% chance to make the target flinch.

Power is doubled against Pokémon that have used minimize since entering the field.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Has a $effect_chance% chance to make the target flinch.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  User charges for one turn before attacking.

During sunny day, the charge turn is skipped.

During hail, rain dance, or sandstorm, power is halved.

This move cannot be selected by sleep talk.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Requires a turn to charge before attacking.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  Has a $effect_chance% chance to paralyze the target.

During rain dance, this move has 100% accuracy.  It also has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection of protect and detect.

During sunny day, this move has 50% accuracy.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Has a $effect_chance% chance to paralyze the target.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Does nothing.  Wild battles end immediately.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Immediately ends wild battles.  No effect otherwise.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Inflicts typeless regular damage.  Every Pokémon in the user's party, excepting those that have fainted or have a major status effect, attacks the target.  Calculated stats are ignored; the base stats for the target and assorted attackers are used instead.  The random factor in the damage formula is not used.  dark Pokémon still get STAB.

This effect breaks through wonder guard.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Hits once for every conscious Pokémon the trainer has.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  User flies high into the air for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn.

During the immune turn, gust, hurricane, sky uppercut, smack down, thunder, twister, and whirlwind still hit the user normally.  gust and twister also have double power against the user.

The damage from hail and sandstorm still applies during the immune turn.

The user may be hit during its immune turn if under the effect of lock on, mind reader, or no guard.

This move cannot be used while gravity is in effect.

This move cannot be selected by sleep talk.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: User flies high into the air, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Raises user's Defense by one stage.

After this move is used, the power of ice ball and rollout are doubled until the user leaves the field.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Raises user's Defense by one stage.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Causes the target to flinch.  Can only be used on the user's first turn after entering the field.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Can only be used as the first move after the user enters battle.  Causes the target to flinch.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Restores 1/16 of the user's max HP at the end of each turn.  If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

This effect is passed on by baton pass.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Restores 1/16 of the user's max HP each turn.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  User is forced to use this move for 2–5 turns, selected at random.  All Pokémon on the field wake up, and none can fall to sleep until the lock-in ends.

Pokémon cannot use rest during this effect.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Forced to use this move for several turns.  Pokémon cannot fall asleep in that time.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Raises the user's Defense and Special Defense by one stage each.  Stores energy for use with spit up and swallow.  Up to three levels of energy can be stored, and all are lost if the user leaves the field.  Energy is still stored even if the stat boosts cannot be applied.

If the user uses baton pass, the stat boosts are passed as normal, but the stored energy is not.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Stores energy up to three times for use with Spit Up and Swallow.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  Power is equal to 100 times the amount of energy stored by stockpile.  Ignores the random factor in the damage formula.  Stored energy is consumed, and the user's Defense and Special Defense are reset to what they would be if stockpile had not been used.  If the user has no energy stored, this move will fail.

This move cannot be copied by mirror move.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Power is 100 times the amount of energy Stockpiled.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Heals the user depending on the amount of energy stored by stockpile: 1/4 its max HP after one use, 1/2 its max HP after two uses, or fully after three uses.  Stored energy is consumed, and the user's Defense and Special Defense are reset to what they would be if stockpile had not been used.  If the user has no energy stored, this move will fail.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Recovers 1/4 HP after one Stockpile, 1/2 HP after two Stockpiles, or full HP after three Stockpiles.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Changes the weather to hail for five turns, during which non-ice Pokémon are damaged for 1/16 their max HP at the end of every turn.

If the user is holding icy rock, this effect lasts for eight turns.

blizzard has 100% accuracy.  If the target has used detect or protect, blizzard has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection.

moonlight, morning sun, and synthesis heal only 1/4 of the user's max HP.

Pokémon with snow cloak are exempt from this effect's damage.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Changes the weather to a hailstorm for five turns.

If the target is forced to attempt a repeated move due to choice band, choice scarf, choice specs, disable, encore, taunt, only having PP remaining for one move, or any other effect, the target will use struggle instead.  The target is then free to use the forced move next turn, as it didn't use that move this turn.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Prevents the target from using the same move twice in a row.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Raises the target's Special Attack by one stage, then confuses it.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Raises the target's Special Attack by one stage and confuses the target.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Burns the target.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Burns the target.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Lowers the target's Attack and Special Attack by two stages.  User faints.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Lowers the target's Attack and Special Attack by two stages.  User faints.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  If the user is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned, this move has double power.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Power doubles if user is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: If the target is paralyzed, inflicts double damage and cures the paralysis.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:

This effect takes priority over lightning rod and storm drain.

If the user's ally switches out, opposing Pokémon may still hit it with pursuit.

This move cannot be selected by assist or metronome.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Redirects the target's single-target effects to the user for this turn.

assist, copycat, me first, metronome, mirror move, and sleep talk do not directly inflict damage and thus may not be used.

bide, counter, endeavor, metal burst, and mirror coat are allowed.

This move cannot be copied by mirror move, nor selected by assist or metronome.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Ally's next move inflicts half more damage.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
User and target permanently swap held items.  Works even if one of the Pokémon isn't holding anything.  If either Pokémon is holding mail, this move will fail.

If either Pokémon has multitype or sticky hold, this move will fail.

If this move results in a Pokémon obtaining choice band, choice scarf, or choice specs, and that Pokémon was the latter of the pair to move this turn, then the move it used this turn becomes its chosen forced move.  This applies even if both Pokémon had a choice item before this move was used.  If the first of the two Pokémon gains a choice item, it may select whatever choice move it wishes next turn.

Neither the user nor the target can recover its item with recycle.

This move cannot be selected by assist or metronome.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: User and target swap items.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
User's ability is replaced with the target's until the user leaves the field.  Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

If the target has flower gift, forecast, illusion, imposter, multitype, stance change, trace, wonder guard, or zen mode, this move will fail.

This move cannot be copied by mirror move.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Copies the target's ability.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: At the end of the next turn, user will be healed for half its max HP.  If the user is switched out, its replacement will be healed instead for half of the user's max HP.  If the user faints or is forcefully switched by roar or whirlwind, this effect will not activate.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: User will recover half its max HP at the end of the next turn.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Uses a move from another Pokémon in the user's party, both selected at random.  Moves from fainted Pokémon can be used.  If there are no eligible Pokémon or moves, this move will fail.

This move will not select assist, chatter, circle throw, copycat, counter, covet, destiny bond, detect, dig, dive, dragon tail, endure, feint, fly focus punch, follow me, helping hand, me first, metronome, mimic, mirror coat, mirror move, phantom force protect, quick guard, roar shadow force, sketch, sleep talk, snatch, struggle, switcheroo, thief, trick, whirlwind, or wide guard.

This move cannot be copied by mirror move, nor selected by metronome or sleep talk.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Randomly selects and uses one of the trainer's other Pokémon's moves.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Prevents the user from switching out.  User regains 1/16 of its max HP at the end of every turn.  If the user was immune to ground attacks, it will now take normal damage from them.

roar and whirlwind will not affect the user.  The user cannot use magnet rise.

The user may still use u turn to leave the field.

This effect can be passed with baton pass.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Prevents the user from leaving battle.  User regains 1/16 of its max HP every turn.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user's Attack and Defense by one stage each.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Lowers the user's Attack and Defense by one stage after inflicting damage.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
The first non-damaging move targeting the user this turn that inflicts major status effects, stat changes, or trapping effects will be reflected at its user.

defog, memento, and teeter dance are not reflected.

attract, flatter, gastro acid, leech seed, swagger, worry seed, and yawn are reflected.

This move cannot be copied by mirror move.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Reflects back the first effect move used on the user this turn.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
User recovers the last item consumed by the user or a Pokémon in its position on the field.  The item must be used again before it can be recovered by this move again.  If the user is holding an item, this move fails.

Items taken or given away by covet, knock off, switcheroo, thief, or trick may not be recovered.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: User recovers the item it last used up.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  If the target damaged the user this turn and was the last to do so, this move has double power.

pain split does not count as damaging the user.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Inflicts double damage if the user takes damage before attacking this turn.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Destroys any light screen or reflect on the target's side of the field, then inflicts regular damage.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Destroys Reflect and Light Screen.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Puts the target to sleep at the end of the next turn.  Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.  If the target leaves the field, this effect is canceled.  If the target has a status effect when this move is used, this move will fail.

If the target is protected by safeguard when this move is used, this move will fail.

insomnia and vital spirit prevent the sleep if the target has either at the end of the next turn, but will not cause this move to fail on use.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Target sleeps at the end of the next turn.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  Target loses its held item.

Neither the user nor the target can recover its item with recycle.

If the target has multitype or sticky hold, it will take damage but not lose its item.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Target drops its held item.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Inflicts exactly enough damage to lower the target's HP to equal the user's.  If the target's HP is not higher than the user's, this move has no effect.  Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored.  This effect counts as damage for moves that respond to damage.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Lowers the target's HP to equal the user's.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Power increases with the user's remaining HP and is given by `150 * HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 150 when the user has full HP.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Inflicts more damage when the user has more HP remaining, with a maximum of 150 power.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
User and target switch abilities.  Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

If either Pokémon has multitype or wonder guard, this move will fail.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: User and target swap abilities.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Prevents any Pokémon on the opposing side of the field from using any move the user knows until the user leaves the field.  This effect is live; if the user obtains new moves while on the field, these moves become restricted.  If no opposing Pokémon knows any of the user's moves when this move is used, this move will fail.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Prevents the target from using any moves that the user also knows.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Removes a burn, paralysis, or poison from the user.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Cleanses the user of a burn, paralysis, or poison.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: If the user faints before it next acts, the move that fainted it will have its PP dropped to 0.  End-of-turn damage does not trigger this effect.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: If the user faints this turn, the PP of the move that fainted it drops to 0.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
The next time a Pokémon uses a beneficial move on itself or itself and its ally this turn, the user of this move will steal the move and use it itself.  Moves which may be stolen by this move are identified by the "snatchable" flag.

If two Pokémon use this move on the same turn, the faster Pokémon will steal the first beneficial move, and the slower Pokémon will then steal it again—thus, only the slowest Pokémon using this move ultimately gains a stolen move's effect.

If the user steals psych up, it will target the Pokémon that used psych up.  If the user was the original target of psych up, and the Pokémon that originally used it's affected by pressure, it will only lose 1 PP.

This move cannot be copied by mirror move, nor selected by assist or metronome.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Steals the target's move, if it's self-targeted.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  Power increases with the target's weight in kilograms, to a maximum of 120.

Target's weight | Power
--------------- | ----:
Up to 10kg      |    20
Up to 25kg      |    40
Up to 50kg      |    60
Up to 100kg     |    80
Up to 200kg     |   100
Above 200kg     |   120
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Inflicts more damage to heavier targets, with a maximum of 120 power.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  If the target is holding a berry, this move has double power, and the user takes the berry and uses it immediately.

If the target is holding a jaboca berry or rowap berry, the berry is still removed, but has no effect.

If this move is super effective and the target is holding a berry that can reduce this move's damage, it will do so, and will not be stolen.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: If target has a berry, inflicts double damage and uses the berry.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: For the next three turns, all Pokémon on the user's side of the field have their original Speed doubled.  This effect remains if the user leaves the field.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: For three turns, friendly Pokémon have doubled Speed.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
For five turns, the user is immune to ground moves.

If the user is under the effect of ingrain or has levitate, this move will fail.

This effect is temporarily disabled by and cannot be used during gravity.

This effect is passed on by baton pass.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: User is immune to Ground moves and effects for five turns.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  Has a $effect_chance% chance to inflict an effect chosen according to the terrain.

Terrain        | Effect
-------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------
Building       | Paralyzes target
Cave           | Makes target flinch
Deep water     | Lowers target's Attack by one stage
Desert         | Lowers target's accuracy by one stage
Grass          | Puts target to sleep
Mountain       | Makes target flinch
Road           | Lowers target's accuracy by one stage
Shallow water  | Lowers target's Attack by one stage
Snow           | Freezes target
Tall grass     | Puts target to sleep

In Pokémon Battle Revolution:

Terrain        | Effect
-------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------
Courtyard      | Paralyzes target
Crystal        | Makes target flinch
Gateway        | Lowers target's Attack by one stage
Magma          | Makes target flinch
Main Street    | Paralyzes target
Neon           | Paralyzes target
Stargazer      | Makes target flinch
Sunny Park     | Puts target to sleep
Sunset         | Lowers target's accuracy by one stage
Waterfall      | Puts target to sleep
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Has a $effect_chance% chance to inflict a status effect which depends upon the terrain.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: User receives 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Confuses all targets.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Confuses the target.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User's critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. Has a $effect_chance% chance to burn the target.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit and a $effect_chance% chance to burn the target.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: electric moves inflict half damage, regardless of target.  If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Halves all Electric-type damage.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a $effect_chance% chance to badly poison the target.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Has a $effect_chance% chance to badly poison the target.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  If a weather move is active, this move has double power, and its type becomes the type of the weather move.  shadow sky is typeless for the purposes of this move.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: If there be weather, this move has doubled power and the weather's type.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user's Special Attack by two stages.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Lowers the user's Special Attack by two stages after inflicting damage.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Lowers the target's Attack and Defense by one stage.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Lowers the target's Attack and Defense by one stage.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Raises the user's Defense and Special Defense by one stage.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Raises the user's Defense and Special Defense by one stage.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.

This move can hit Pokémon under the effect of bounce, fly, or sky drop.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Bounce and Fly users.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Raises the user's Attack and Defense by one stage each.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Raises the user's Attack and Defense by one stage.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User's critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. Has a $effect_chance% chance to poison the target.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit and a $effect_chance% chance to poison the target.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: fire moves inflict half damage, regardless of target.  If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Halves all Fire-type damage.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Raises the user's Special Attack and Special Defense by one stage each.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Raises the user's Special Attack and Special Defense by one stage.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Raises the user's Attack and Speed by one stage each.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Raises the user's Attack and Speed by one stage.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
User's type changes according to the terrain.

Terrain        | New type
-------------- | --------------
Building       | normal
Cave           | rock
Desert         | ground
Grass          | grass
Mountain       | rock
Ocean          | water
Pond           | water
Road           | ground
Snow           | ice
Tall grass     | grass

In Pokémon Battle Revolution:

Terrain        | New type
-------------- | --------------

Crystal        | rock

Magma          | rock
Main Street    | normal
Neon           | normal
Stargazer      | rock
Sunny Park     | grass
Sunset         | ground
Waterfall      | grass
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: User's type changes to match the terrain.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Heals the user for half its max HP.  If the user is flying, its flying type is ignored until the end of this turn.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Heals the user by half its max HP.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
For five turns (including this one), all immunities to ground moves are disabled.  For the duration of this effect, the evasion of every Pokémon on the field is lowered by two stages.  Cancels the effects of bounce, fly, and sky drop.

Specifically, flying Pokémon and those with levitate or that have used magnet rise are no longer immune to ground attacks, arena trap, spikes, or toxic spikes.

bounce, fly, sky drop, high jump kick, jump kick, and splash cannot be used while this move is in effect.

*Bug*: If this move is used during a double or triple battle while Pokémon are under the effect of sky drop, Sky Drop's effect is not correctly canceled on its target, and it remains high in the air indefinitely.  As Sky Drop prevents the target from acting, the only way to subsequently remove it from the field is to faint it.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Disables moves and immunities that involve flying or levitating for five turns.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Resets the target's evasion to normal and prevents any further boosting until the target leaves the field.  A dark Pokémon under this effect takes normal damage from psychic moves.  This move itself ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Forces the target to have no evasion, and allows it to be hit by Psychic moves even if it's Dark.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  If the target is sleeping, this move has double power, and the target wakes up.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: If the target is asleep, has double power and wakes it up.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user's Speed by one stage.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Lowers user's Speed by one stage.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Power increases with the target's current Speed compared to the user, given by `1 + 25 * target Speed / user Speed`, capped at 150.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Power raises when the user has lower Speed, up to a maximum of 150.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: User faints.  Its replacement's HP is fully restored, and any major status effect is removed.  If the replacement Pokémon is immediately fainted by a switch-in effect, the next replacement is healed by this move instead.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: User faints.  Its replacement has its HP fully restored and any major status effect removed.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  If the target has less than half its max HP remaining, this move has double power.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Has double power against Pokémon that have less than half their max HP remaining.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Power and type are determined by the user's held berry.  The berry is consumed.  If the user is not holding a berry, this move will fail.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Power and type depend on the held berry.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: User swaps its stat modifiers with the target.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: User and target swap stat changes.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Raises one of the target's stats by two stages.  The raised stat is chosen at random from any stats that can be raised by two stages.  If no stat is eligible, this move will fail.

If the target has a substitute, this move will have no effect, even if the user is the target.

This move cannot be copied by mirror move.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Raises one of a friendly Pokémon's stats at random by two stages.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Targets the last opposing Pokémon to hit the user with a damaging move this turn.  Inflicts 1.5× the damage that move did to the user.  If there is no eligible target, this move will fail.  Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Strikes back at the last Pokémon to hit the user this turn with 1.5× the damage.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Inflicts regular damage, then the user immediately switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party.  If the target faints from this attack, the user's trainer selects the new Pokémon to send out first.  If the user is the last Pokémon in its party that can battle, it will not switch out.

The user may be hit by pursuit when it switches out, if it has been targeted and pursuit has not yet been used.

This move may be used even if the user is under the effect of ingrain.  ingrain's effect will end.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: User must switch out after attacking.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by one stage each.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by one stage after inflicting damage.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  If the target uses a move or switches out this turn before this move is used, this move has double power.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Power is doubled if the target has already moved this turn.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  If the target takes damage this turn for any reason before this move is used, this move has double power.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Power is doubled if the target has already received damage this turn.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Target cannot use its held item for five turns.  If the target leaves the field, this effect ends.

If a Pokémon under this effect uses bug bite or pluck on a Pokémon holding a berry, the berry is destroyed but not used.  If a Pokémon under this effect uses fling, it will fail.

This effect is passed by baton pass.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Target cannot use held items.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  Power and type are determined by the user's held item.  The item is consumed.  If the user is not holding an item, or its item has no set type and power, this move will fail.

This move ignores sticky hold.

If the user is under the effect of embargo, this move will fail.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Throws held item at the target; power depends on the item.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: If the user has a major status effect and the target does not, the user's status is transferred to the target.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Transfers the user's major status effect to the target.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  Power is determined by the PP remaining for this move, after its PP cost is deducted.  Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

PP remaining | Power
------------ | ----:
4 or more    |    40
3            |    50
2            |    60
1            |    80
0            |   200

If this move is activated by another move, the activating move's PP is used to calculate power.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Power increases when this move has less PP, up to a maximum of 200.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: For the next five turns, the target may not use any moves that only restore HP, and move effects that heal the target are disabled.  Moves that steal HP may still be used, but will only inflict damage and not heal the target.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Prevents target from restoring its HP for five turns.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Power directly relates to the target's relative remaining HP, given by `1 + 120 * current HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 121.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Power increases against targets with more HP remaining, up to a maximum of 121 power.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
The user's original Attack and Defense are swapped.

This effect is passed on by baton pass.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: User swaps Attack and Defense.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
The target's ability is disabled as long as it remains on the field.

This effect is passed on by baton pass.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Nullifies target's ability until it leaves battle.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: For five turns, opposing Pokémon cannot score critical hits.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Prevents the target from scoring critical hits for five turns.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
If the target has selected a damaging move this turn, the user will copy that move and use it against the target, with a 50% increase in power.

If the target moves before the user, this move will fail.

This move cannot be copied by mirror move, nor selected by assist, metronome, or sleep talk.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Uses the target's move against it before it attacks, with power increased by half.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Uses the last move that was used successfully by any Pokémon, including the user.

This move cannot copy itself, nor roar nor whirlwind.

This move cannot be copied by mirror move, nor selected by assist, metronome, or sleep talk.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Uses the target's last used move.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: User swaps its Attack and Special Attack stat modifiers modifiers with the target.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: User swaps Attack and Special Attack changes with the target.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: User swaps its Defense and Special Defense modifiers with the target.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: User swaps Defense and Special Defense changes with the target.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Power starts at 60 and is increased by 20 for every stage any of the target's stats has been raised, capping at 200.  Accuracy and evasion modifiers do not increase this move's power.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Power increases against targets with more raised stats, up to a maximum of 200.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  This move can only be used if each of the user's other moves has been used at least once since the user entered the field.  If this is the user's only move, this move will fail.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Can only be used after all of the user's other moves have been used.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Changes the target's ability to insomnia.

If the target's ability is truant or multitype, this move will fail.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Changes the target's ability to Insomnia.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  If the target has not selected a damaging move this turn, or if the target has already acted this turn, this move will fail.

This move is not affected by iron fist.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Only works if the target is about to use a damaging move.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Scatters poisoned spikes around the opposing field, which poison opposing Pokémon that enter the field.  A second layer of these spikes may be laid down, in which case Pokémon will be badly poisoned instead.  Pokémon immune to either ground moves or being poisoned are immune to this effect.  Pokémon otherwise immune to ground moves are affected during gravity.

If a poison Pokémon not immune to ground moves enters a field covered with poisoned spikes, the spikes are removed.

rapid spin will remove this effect from its user's side of the field.  defog will remove this effect from its target's side of the field.

This move does not trigger synchronize, unless the Pokémon with synchronize was forced to enter the field by another effect such as roar.

Pokémon entering the field due to baton pass are not affected by this effect.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Scatters poisoned spikes, poisoning opposing Pokémon that switch in.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil.  Has a $effect_chance% chance to burn the target.  Frozen Pokémon may use this move, in which case they will thaw.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: User takes 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil.  Has a $effect_chance% chance to burn the target.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Inflicts typeless regular damage.  User takes 1/4 its max HP in recoil.  Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

This move is used automatically when a Pokémon cannot use any other move legally, e.g., due to having no PP remaining or being under the effect of both encore and torment at the same time.

This move's recoil is not treated as recoil for the purposes of anything that affects recoil, such as the ability rock head.  It also is not prevented by magic guard.

This move cannot be copied by mimic, mirror move, or sketch, nor selected by assist or metronome, nor forced by encore.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: User takes 1/4 its max HP in recoil.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  User dives underwater for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn.

During the immune turn, surf, and whirlpool still hit the user normally, and their power is doubled if appropriate.

The user may be hit during its immune turn if under the effect of lock on, mind reader, or no guard.

This move cannot be selected by sleep talk.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: User dives underwater, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  User digs underground for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn.

During the immune turn, earthquake, fissure, and magnitude still hit the user normally, and their power is doubled if appropriate.

The user may be hit during its immune turn if under the effect of lock on, mind reader, or no guard.

This move cannot be selected by sleep talk.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: User digs underground, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn.

pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.

If the target is in the first turn of dive, this move will hit with double power.
pokemon_v2_moveeffecteffecttext.short_effect: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Dive users.
